name: pelican
title: Pelican Panel + Wings
description: Open-source game server management panel with a companion Wings daemon. Supports SQLite or MySQL, keeps its cache, sessions and queue in a small Valkey (Redis) container, works behind Traefik/Cloudflare. DCS does the first run itself: the database, an admin (user admin, password in the secret PELICAN_ADMIN_PASSWORD), this machine as the node and Wings' config. The panel answers at panel.<domain>, Wings at play.<domain>; game ports and SFTP go to this machine directly (forward them on the router).
auth_note: Pelican signs people in itself, and Wings is called by the panel and the browser with its own token: both routes stay off Authelia.

variables.name: PANEL_APP_URL
variables.label: Panel URL
variables.description: Leave empty: DCS fills it with the panel's route (https://panel.<domain>), else http://<this server>:<panel port>

variables.name: PANEL_SUBDOMAIN
variables.label: Panel subdomain
variables.description: The panel's address is https://<this>.<your domain>

variables.name: WINGS_SUBDOMAIN
variables.label: Wings subdomain
variables.description: Wings' address (the node's FQDN) is https://<this>.<your domain>: the panel and the browser's console talk to it

variables.name: PANEL_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.label: Admin Email
variables.description: Email of the admin user DCS makes on the first run (username admin)

variables.name: PANEL_PORT_HTTP
variables.label: Panel HTTP Port
variables.description: Host port for the Panel web interface

variables.name: PANEL_PORT_HTTPS
variables.label: Panel HTTPS Port
variables.description: Host port for HTTPS (only used when not behind proxy)

variables.name: PANEL_BEHIND_PROXY
variables.label: Behind Reverse Proxy
variables.description: Set to true when using Traefik, Cloudflare, or any reverse proxy for TLS

options.label: No — Panel handles TLS directly (needs Let's Encrypt)

variables.name: PANEL_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.label: Trusted Proxies
variables.description: Which IPs to trust for forwarded HTTPS headers

variables.name: PANEL_DB_HOST
variables.label: MySQL Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP of your MySQL server

variables.name: PANEL_DB_NAME
variables.label: MySQL Database
variables.description: For MySQL: the database name (e.g. pelican). The default is SQLite's file in the persistent /pelican-data: keep it for SQLite

variables.name: WINGS_UID
variables.label: Wings User ID
variables.description: System UID for Wings (match your host pelican-wings user)

variables.name: PELICAN_SERVER_DIR
variables.label: Server Files Directory
variables.description: Absolute host path where game server files are stored
